integrity: The proof supplies a geometric equivariant retraction and an exact fixed-representation sphere model; accompanying code independently enumerates fixed-complex faces for 17 orbit partitions.
scientific_limitations: Only dissociation complexes (r=2) of spiders with at least two identical three-edge arms, and arm-permutation subgroup actions; no classification of heterogeneous arms or other r. Finite mod-two checks corroborate but do not prove the integral homotopy theorem.
title: Orbit-count fixed-point spheres for the dissociation complexes of three-edge spiders
